title: Go-Jo · Milkshake Man (Eurovision 2025 Live)
description: The complete Eurovision 2025 live performance: retro CRT TV infomercial, red-and-white diner curtains, black-and-white optical checkerboard LED floor, giant glowing milkshake blender, neon lime/amber/pink smoke reveals, French bridge, red milk-splash overhead, shirtless climax and retro TV finale. Original instrumental with two physical mouth-engine voices.
